title: Complete English UI Localization (Parse Columns v2.0.9)
user_request_origin: chuyển sang tiếng anh hết đi... giống tới 99% so với parse_columns_mockup.html
user_story: As a global developer or data analyst using Toad, I want all labels, natural language sentences, placeholders, tooltips, dialog headers, buttons, error badges, and SQL previews in 100% standard English so the tool aligns seamlessly with modern development environments.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Eliminates mixed-language cognitive friction. Standard English terminology (e.g., 'Extract from', 'using', 'split by', 'Discovered Fields', 'Click to rename', 'Verify 1k rows', 'Apply') conforms to international standards and matches cloud log analysis tools.
description: Every UI element in the mockup—including the natural language bar, Rules popover, column table, status bar, and toast notifications—is authored strictly in English matching parse_columns_mockup.html.
acceptance_criteria: All text strings across headers, natural language sentence controls, toolbars, tables, and footers are in English.
Live SQL generated code contains English comments and standard DuckDB keywords.
Toast notifications, validation badges, and modal dialogs are 100% English.
Exact match with text content of parse_columns_mockup.html.

technical_specs.typography: Inter (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont), JetBrains Mono for code elements

cognitive_load_optimization: Provides clean, unambiguous, universal terminology without translation hesitation or mixed-language UI artifacts.

title: Design System View Bar & Multi-Edition Switcher
user_request_origin: thanh switcher chọn các edition: Original v2.0.9, Google UX, Minimalist (Zen)
user_story: As a design stakeholder or developer, I want a top switcher bar allowing instant switching between Original v2.0.9, Google UX, and Minimalist (Zen) Edition with live status badge and subtitle so I can evaluate and compare UX paradigms.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Housing all 3 design evolutions in a single interactive artifact allows stakeholders to directly experience the benefits of the Minimalist Zen Edition compared to Google UX and legacy v2.0.9.
description: A top control bar with dark styling (bg-slate-900, text-white, border-slate-700), containing the Design System View badge (#uxBadgeLabel), benefits subtitle (#uxSubDesc), edition buttons (#uxSwitchOriginal, #uxSwitchGoogle, #uxSwitchMinimal), and the UX Case Study drawer button.
acceptance_criteria: Top switcher bar renders with max-width 850px, dark slate styling, and design icon.
Clicking 'Original v2.0.9' activates legacy layout with full boxed configuration.
Clicking 'Google UX' activates modern Google Cloud layout with smart filters and progress bars.
Clicking 'Minimalist' activates the Zen Edition (active by default on page load).
Clicking 'UX Case Study' toggles the 5 Key Improvements modal.

technical_specs.container_class: w-full max-w-[850px] bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-slate-700

cognitive_load_optimization: Consolidates multiple design evolutions into a single interactive prototype for clear stakeholder alignment.

title: Minimalist Zen Container Layout & Proportions
user_request_origin: giao diện zen tối giản, loại bỏ viền lồng viền (zero box-in-box clutter)
user_story: As a user, I want the dialog container in Minimalist Zen mode to be compact (max-width 680px), with smooth rounded corners (12px), subtle shadow, and clean custom scrollbars so the dialog feels modern, lightweight, and focused.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Standard desktop dialogs (850px) are often too wide for simple log parsing tasks. Narrowing to 680px with 12px border radius and deep diffuse shadow (`0 20px 40px -15px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07)`) creates a focused, high-density tool.
description: When Minimalist mode is active, the body receives the `.zen-mode` class, which constrains `#mainModalContainer` to 680px, applies 12px border radius, and streamlines scrollbars to 5px transparent tracks with rounded thumbs.
acceptance_criteria: Body receives '.zen-mode' class when Minimalist edition is active.
Container max-width adjusts from 850px to 680px with 12px border-radius.
Shadow adjusts to 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07).
Scrollbars in table streamline to 5px transparent track with rounded thumb.
cognitive_load_optimization: Constrains visual scanning distance, focusing user attention directly on the essential extraction workflow.

title: Top Header Bar with Monochromatic Split Icon & Visual vs Regex Segmented Switcher
user_request_origin: bỏ số này đi được không... (ảnh chụp badge v2.0.9 cạnh Parse Columns) và các icon đều dạng đơn sắc được không?
user_story: As an engineer, I want the header to display the Split Column icon, 'Parse Columns v2.0.9', and a segmented Visual / Regex control so I can switch between visual configuration and RE2 regex capture groups.
rationale_and_design_decisions:
1. Removing the static 'v2.0.9' version pill badge next to the dialog title eliminates redundant version noise from the primary workflow.
2. Enforcing a strict monochromatic palette (text-slate-700, text-slate-600, text-slate-500, currentColor) across all vector SVG icons creates an ultra-premium, cohesive, distraction-free aesthetic matching developer tools like Linear and GitHub.
description: Header featuring monochromatic Split Column SVG icon (text-slate-700), clean 'Parse Columns' title without version pill clutter, segmented monochromatic mode switch ('Visual' with slate lightning bolt vs 'Regex' with slate wrench), and minimal close button.
acceptance_criteria: Header displays monochromatic Split Column SVG (text-slate-700) and 'Parse Columns' title.
Redundant 'v2.0.9' version badge pill is removed from the dialog header.
All icons across header, mode switch, toolbars, tables, and footers employ a unified monochromatic palette.
No multicolored emojis (⚡, ✨, 🎨) remain; all icons are rendered as crisp vector SVGs.
Segmented button allows switching between 'Visual' and 'Regex' modes with instant DOM reactivity.

technical_specs.header_class: px-5 py-3 bg-[#f8fafc] border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between

cognitive_load_optimization: Eliminates distracting version labels and color noise, letting data and column names remain the primary visual focus.

title: Natural Language Extraction Config Bar (#minimalTopBar)
user_request_origin: theo bạn phần này có thể gom thành 1 được không ? gom thành 1 thanh đọc như văn bản tự nhiên
user_story: As a user, I want the extraction parameters presented as a single readable sentence: 'Extract from [Details ▾] using [Key=Value ▾] split by [ ¦ ] and [ : ]' with inline inputs so I can configure parsing rules without boxy panels.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Replaces 3 fragmented configuration cards with a single natural language prose bar. Translating configuration into a fluid sentence mirrors natural human language and cuts vertical height by over 60%.
description: The Minimalist Natural Language Bar renders inline sentence controls with select dropdowns for source column and format, and compact monospace inputs for delimiter and assign characters.
acceptance_criteria: Renders sentence: 'Extract from [Details ▾] using [Key=Value ▾] split by [ ¦ ] and [ : ]'.
Source select (#minSourceSelect) contains Details, RawPayload, EventMessage.
Format select (#minFormatSelect) contains Key=Value, JSON, CSV.
Delimiter input (#minDelimInput) and Assign input (#minAssignInput) allow custom token editing.
Syncs bidirectionally with classic controls via syncMinimalConfig().
cognitive_load_optimization: Zero box-in-box clutter. Configuration reads like natural English, eliminating mental overhead.

title: Advanced Extraction Rules Popover (#minimalRulesPopover)
user_request_origin: giấu các tùy chọn phụ như header prefix và quote enclosure vào popover
user_story: As an analyst parsing logs with syslog headers, I want advanced extraction rules stowed inside a clean Rules popover with an indicator dot so they don't clutter the natural language bar unless needed.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Header Prefix separation (`:`) and Quote Wrapper (`" .. "`) are secondary knobs. Stowing them in an absolute popover card accessed via a clean `Rules` button with a blue dot keeps the natural language bar focused while keeping advanced rules 1 click away.
description: A 'Rules' button with a blue dot indicator toggles `#minimalRulesPopover`, containing Header Prefix checkbox, Header Column Name input (`log_header`), and Quote Wrapper indicator (`" .. "`).
acceptance_criteria: Rules button displays SVG sliders icon and blue dot indicator.
Clicking Rules toggles #minimalRulesPopover open/closed smoothly.
Contains checkbox for Header Prefix (`:`), header column name input (`log_header`), and quote pair indicator.
Toggling header prefix or editing column name updates live SQL immediately.
cognitive_load_optimization: Progressive disclosure: secondary controls remain hidden until requested, freeing up visual focus.

title: Sample Event Editor with Line Gutter, 1 of 50 Cycler & 1-Click Copy
user_request_origin: Sample Event có line number 01, duyệt Row 1 of 50, nút Copy
user_story: As a user, I want to inspect sample events in a code editor box with line numbering (01), cycle through 50 realistic sample events using Prev/Next buttons, and copy the active event with 1 click so I can test parsing rules on varied payloads.
rationale_and_design_decisions: A compact code editor with a fixed 01 line gutter provides professional developer ergonomics. Integrating sample navigation (Row 1 of 50) and 1-click copy directly into the Sample Event header removes clutter while enabling instant testing across diverse event streams.
description: The Sample Event card displays the current sample text in a monospace textarea with a line gutter, accompanied by row index indicator ('Row 1 of 50'), Prev/Next cycle buttons, and a 1-click Copy button with visual feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Displays active row number ('Row 1 of 50') with working Prev (<) and Next (>) navigation buttons.
Sample text area features a dedicated left gutter with '01' line numbering.
Copy button copies active sample text to clipboard and flashes 'Copied!' feedback.
Typing in textarea updates live SQL preview immediately.
cognitive_load_optimization: Provides instant developer-grade inspection with line numbers and rapid dataset cycling in a single compact card.

title: Classic Source Column & Visual Config Panels (for Google & Original Editions)
user_request_origin: giữ nguyên các panel gốc cho chế độ Google UX và Original v2.0.9
user_story: As a reviewer comparing design editions, I want the classic Source Column section, Format & Delimiter panel, and Regex panel fully available when switching to Google UX or Original v2.0.9 modes.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Preserving the classic panel structure inside `#classicSourceSection`, `#visualConfigPanel`, and `#regexConfigPanel` ensures 100% fidelity when comparing the Minimalist Zen mode against Google UX and Original v2.0.9.
description: Contains `#classicSourceSection` with double blue focus ring (.source-focus-ring) and refresh button, `#visualConfigPanel` with 2-row layout (Format + Header Prefix row; Delimiter, Assign, Quote Pair row), and `#regexConfigPanel` with RE2 pattern input.
acceptance_criteria: In Google UX and Original modes, #classicSourceSection and #visualConfigPanel are visible.
In Minimalist mode, classic panels are cleanly hidden in favor of #minimalTopBar.
Source select features .source-focus-ring and spinning refresh icon #refreshIcon.
Quote pair inputs support multi-word enclosure customization.
cognitive_load_optimization: Seamlessly shows or hides legacy complexity based on the chosen design edition.

title: Single-Line Discovered Fields Toolbar with Instant Column Search
user_request_origin: tôi muốn gom thành 1 dòng được không... (ảnh chụp thanh công cụ Discovered Fields bị rớt dòng)
user_story: As a user, I want a clean search bar with an embedded magnifying glass, field count badge ('Discovered Fields (13)'), and quick action buttons (All, None, + strX) so I can filter and manage fields without clutter.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Preventing multi-line wrapping in the 680px Zen dialog maximizes vertical workspace. By tightening search width to 144px-176px (w-36 sm:w-44), streamlining button paddings (px-2 py-1 text-[11px]), and fixing the duplicate '+ + strX' label into a clean '+ strX', all 5 controls (Field count, Search input, ≥50% Rate smart filter, + strX adder, and All/None toggle) fit harmoniously across a single 26px-height line without wrapping.
description: Unified single-line toolbar without flex-wrap. Arranges 'Discovered Fields (13)' and search input on the left, and quick action buttons ('⚡ ≥50% Rate', '+ strX', and 'All' / 'None') on the right on one contiguous horizontal row.
acceptance_criteria: All toolbar controls (Field count, Search input, Smart filter, + strX, All/None) remain on a single contiguous horizontal line.
Container employs 'flex items-center justify-between gap-2' without flex-wrap.
Search input uses compact width (w-36 to sm:w-44) with embedded search icon.
'+ strX' button cleanly renders with a single '+' symbol and amber badge styling.
Fits comfortably inside the 680px Zen container with zero awkward line breaks.

technical_specs.container_class: flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 text-xs

cognitive_load_optimization: Eliminates vertical fragmentation by maintaining a single, uninterrupted horizontal toolbar, preserving vertical space for the column mapping table.

title: Smart Bulk Selection Filter (⚡ ≥50% Rate Pill)
user_request_origin: Smart Filter Pill ⚡ ≥50% Rate chọn nhanh các trường có độ phủ cao
user_story: As a data engineer parsing sparse or semi-structured event streams, I want a 1-click '⚡ ≥50% Rate' smart filter that selects only high-frequency fields and deselects noisy tail keys so I don't have to manually uncheck dozens of sparse fields.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Real-world logs often produce dozens of sparse keys (<10% occurrence). Providing a 1-click '⚡ ≥50% Rate' smart filter saves data engineers from tedious manual unchecking, speeding up schema definition by 80%.
description: A smart pill button that evaluates the fill rate of all discovered fields and checks only fields with occurrence rate ≥50%, immediately updating schema state and live SQL.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking '⚡ ≥50% Rate' checks all fields with rate >= 50% and unchecks fields < 50%.
Table re-renders immediately to reflect the updated checked states.
Displays toast confirmation: 'Selected fields with ≥50% occurrence rate'.
Master checkbox and Apply count badge synchronize immediately.

technical_specs.classes: px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 font-semibold

cognitive_load_optimization: Automates repetitive manual filtering of sparse fields into a single high-confidence click.

title: Positional Field Extractor (+ + strX Button)
user_request_origin: + strX button để trích xuất token vị trí unkeyed
user_story: As a log engineer parsing hybrid logs with leading unkeyed tokens, I want to add sequential positional fields (+ strX) with 1 click so unkeyed tokens (e.g. usernames, IDs) can be extracted alongside key-value pairs.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Logs frequently combine unkeyed positional tokens with key-value payloads. Dedicated `+ strX` button allows adding positional tokens (`str1`, `str2`, etc.) that map to SPLIT_PART indexes, preventing data loss for unkeyed tokens.
description: A prominent `+ strX` button adds a new positional field to the top of the table with amber styling, 100% rate, and SPLIT_PART SQL generation.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking '+ strX' prepends a new positional field (str1, str2...) to the mapping table.
Positional fields feature distinct amber styling to differentiate from key-value pairs.
Generates SPLIT_PART SQL extraction clauses instead of regex.
Displays toast notification confirming addition of the positional column.

technical_specs.classes: px-3 py-1 rounded bg-[#fef3c7] hover:bg-[#fde68a] text-[#b45309] border border-[#fcd34d] font-bold

cognitive_load_optimization: Provides clear visual distinction for positional tokens without requiring complex regex syntax.

title: Interactive Click-to-Sort Table Headers (Dual Minimal & Classic Headers)
user_request_origin: đầu mỗi cột cho phép sort là được... click vào header để sort
user_story: As a user reviewing extracted fields, I want to click any table column header (Column, Sample Value, Type, Fill) to sort ascending or descending with visual indicators (⇅, ▲, ▼) so I can organize fields by name, rate, or type.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Table headers serve as natural sorting controls. Clicking on headers directly aligns with user expectations across desktop and web applications, replacing separate sort dropdowns.
description: All headers in the Minimalist table (#minimalTableHeader) and Classic table (#classicTableHeader) are clickable sort toggles that sort the field list and display directional sort indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Column' sorts alphabetically by field name.
Clicking 'Sample Value' sorts by sample string value.
Clicking 'Type' sorts by SQL data type.
Clicking 'Fill' sorts by occurrence rate percentage.
Repeated clicks toggle between ascending and descending order.
cognitive_load_optimization: Embeds sorting directly into column headers, eliminating redundant sorting menus.

title: Merged Column Typography with Inline Click-to-Rename Interaction
user_request_origin: bỏ chữ click to rename được không... (ảnh chụp tiêu đề cột COLUMN (CLICK TO RENAME))
user_story: As a user, I want the discovered Key and New Name merged into a single column where I can simply click any column name to rename it inline so the table is clean, legible, and free of redundant input boxes.
rationale_and_design_decisions: In 90% of log extraction tasks, users keep the original key name. Displaying 13+ static input boxes across every row creates overwhelming visual noise. Merging Key and New Name into a click-to-rename label eliminates dozens of redundant input boxes. Clicking transforms the text into an input box; pressing Enter or blurring renames it and displays `key → newName`.
description: The Minimalist table header displays a clean 'Column' label, removing the verbose '(Click to rename)' instruction while retaining full inline click-to-rename functionality on the row items. Rows render key names as clean typography with a subtle hover pencil icon (✎). Clicking switches to an inline text input; pressing Enter or blurring updates the alias smoothly.
acceptance_criteria: Table header displays clean 'Column' label instead of verbose 'Column (Click to rename)'.
Hover tooltip on 'Column' header provides guidance: 'Click to sort • Click any column below to rename'.
Default state in rows shows key name as clean typography with hover pencil indicator (✎).
Clicking on any column name transforms it into an inline focused text input (#inlineRenameInput_{id}).
Pressing Enter or blurring saves the new name and displays 'key → newName' tag.
Zero permanent static input boxes clutter the table.

technical_specs.renamed_tag: →{field.newName}

cognitive_load_optimization: Removes redundant parenthetical instructions from column headers, maintaining a clean, ultra-minimalist data grid.

title: Ghost Type Selector & Native DuckDB Auto-Casting
user_request_origin: Auto-cast DuckDB types luôn được bật, chọn lại kiểu mờ phẳng nhẹ nhàng
user_story: As a data engineer, I want extracted columns automatically cast to their inferred types (BIGINT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN) via clean ghost selectors, while selecting 'VARCHAR' gracefully disables casting for that specific column.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Heavy select boxes with thick borders create a noisy grid appearance. Ghost selectors (borderless, transparent until hovered) look elegant and unobtrusive. Inferred numeric types default to auto-casting via TRY_CAST, while selecting 'VARCHAR' disables casting without requiring a separate global toggle.
description: Ghost type dropdowns (`string`, `int64`, `float`, `bool`) that render borderless on normal state. Non-string types generate TRY_CAST in DuckDB SQL; string types output bare expressions.
acceptance_criteria: Ghost dropdown provides string (VARCHAR), int64 (BIGINT), float (DOUBLE), and bool (BOOLEAN) options.
Transparent background with subtle hover highlight; no heavy borders.
Changing type immediately updates live DuckDB SQL preview.
Non-string types generate CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(...) AS TYPE) AS "colName".

technical_specs.classes: bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-200/60 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-mono-code font-medium text-slate-600 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer

cognitive_load_optimization: Replaces bulky dropdowns with light typography, keeping the interface uncluttered while retaining full type control.

title: Monochromatic Rate Indicator Dots & Hover-Reveal Column Deletion
user_request_origin: giảm thiểu quá tải nhận thức, tận dụng icon nhiều nhất có thể, nút xóa cột nhanh
user_story: As an analyst reviewing fields, I want field fill rate displayed as a clean colored dot with percentage, which smoothly reveals a 1-click delete button (✕) on hover so I can prune unwanted fields effortlessly.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Replacing bulky progress bars with a simple indicator dot (emerald for high-frequency, amber for sparse) and percentage number declutters the table. Revealing the delete `✕` button only on row hover keeps rows clean until action is needed.
description: The Fill column displays a colored dot (`bg-emerald-500` for ≥50%, `bg-amber-400` for <50%) with rate text (e.g. `82%`). On row hover, the percentage smoothly transforms into a `✕` delete button for 1-click removal.
acceptance_criteria: Displays a circular color dot indicator: emerald (≥50%) or amber (<50%).
Displays monospace percentage number by default (e.g., '82%').
Hovering over the row reveals the '✕' remove button in place of percentage.
Clicking '✕' immediately removes the field from output schema and displays toast notice.
cognitive_load_optimization: Employs contextual hover disclosure to keep the resting interface serene and clean.

title: Real-Time SQL Schema Guardrails & Duplicate Name Detection
user_request_origin: Live duplicate name validation cảnh báo khi trùng tên cột
user_story: As a database user, I want the system to warn me immediately if two columns share the same name and disable the Apply button so I never execute invalid SQL statements with duplicate column identifiers.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Executing a SQL query with duplicate column names causes immediate query execution failure. Detecting duplicate names in real time, highlighting them, displaying an informative warning badge, and disabling the Apply button provides proactive error prevention.
description: Real-time validator monitors active checked column names. If duplicate names are detected, displays `⚠️ Duplicate column name detected` badge in footer and disables the Apply button.
acceptance_criteria: Continuously monitors checked column names for duplicates (case-insensitive).
Displays '⚠️ Duplicate column name detected' badge in footer when duplicates exist.
Disables Apply button (adds opacity-50 and pointer-events-none) until conflict is resolved.
Warning clears and Apply button re-enables as soon as unique names are restored.

technical_specs.validation_logic: const duplicateNames = activeNames.filter((item, idx) => item && activeNames.indexOf(item) !== idx);

cognitive_load_optimization: Provides instant guardrails that prevent errors before execution, eliminating debugging frustration.

title: 1,000-Row Batch Verification (Inline Footer vs Classic Box)
user_request_origin: 1,000 Rows Test: Verify 1k rows ở footer trong zen mode và box trong classic mode
user_story: As an engineer, I want the 1,000-row test integrated into the footer as a compact '▶ Verify 1k rows' button in Zen mode, while available as an expansive progress box in Classic mode.
rationale_and_design_decisions: A separate 1,000-row test box in the dialog body consumes valuable vertical space. Moving verification to an inline button in the footer bar (`▶ Verify 1k rows`) preserves the testing capability while maintaining a compact, Zen dialog layout.
description: In Minimalist mode, an inline '▶ Verify 1k rows' button resides in the footer next to the latency indicator. In Classic mode, `#thousandTestBox` displays progress bar and detailed status.
acceptance_criteria: Footer displays 'Ready (< 15ms)' status and '▶ Verify 1k rows' button.
Clicking '▶ Verify 1k rows' executes simulated scan across 1,000 active rows.
Displays updated latency (e.g. '11.4ms') and toast notice: '1,000 rows test completed (99.4% match)'.
Bulky 1,000-row card box is cleanly hidden in Zen mode and shown in Classic mode.
cognitive_load_optimization: Keeps the primary canvas focused on column mapping while keeping verification immediately accessible.

title: Collapsible Live DuckDB SQL Preview with Caret & 1-Click Copy
user_request_origin: SQL Preview có caret xoay và nút Copy, mặc định đóng
user_story: As a data engineer, I want the live DuckDB SQL preview collapsed by default with an expandable caret and 1-click Copy button so the dialog stays compact while giving me instant access to the exact SQL query.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Showing raw SQL permanently consumes excessive screen space. Collapsing the preview by default with a rotating caret and dedicated Copy button keeps the interface clean while allowing advanced users to inspect and copy SQL statements with 1 click.
description: Collapsible SQL preview container that generates vectorized DuckDB SQL queries (with REGEXP_EXTRACT, SPLIT_PART, and CAST) and provides 1-click clipboard copy.
acceptance_criteria: SQL Preview is collapsed by default to save dialog height.
Clicking 'SQL Preview' toggles the container open/closed with rotating caret animation (#sqlCaret).
Copy button copies exact SQL code to clipboard and flashes 'Copied!' label (#copySqlLabel).
SQL updates in real time whenever delimiters, formats, column names, or types change.
cognitive_load_optimization: Keeps complex SQL code tucked away until needed, maintaining an uncluttered workspace.

title: Action-Oriented Primary CTA with Column Count (Apply Badge)
user_request_origin: nút Apply có thêm số lượng cột: Apply (13)
user_story: As a user completing column extraction, I want the Apply button to display the exact count of columns that will be added (e.g. 'Apply (13)') so I have clear, unambiguous confirmation before materializing the schema.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Displaying the count of selected columns directly inside the Apply button (`Apply (13)`) provides instant visual confirmation of how many new columns will be generated in the dataset, preventing accidental extraction of unintended fields.
description: The primary CTA button features an embedded pill badge (`applyCountBadge`) that dynamically updates with the count of currently checked fields.
acceptance_criteria: Apply button displays current count of checked columns (e.g., 'Apply [13]').
Toggling any checkbox in the table immediately updates the badge number.
Clicking Apply displays toast notification with extracted column count.
Button disabled if 0 columns are selected or if duplicate names exist.
cognitive_load_optimization: Provides clear feedback on the exact consequence of the user's action before execution.

title: Google Cloud & Minimalist UX Case Study Modal
user_request_origin: UX Case Study modal giải thích 5 điểm cải tiến lớn
user_story: As a design stakeholder or engineer, I want an integrated UX Case Study modal detailing the 5 key UX innovations over legacy dialogs so the design rationale is transparent and well-documented.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Embedding the design rationale directly into the prototype bridges the gap between design concepts and technical implementation. Stakeholders can review the exact justification for each architectural decision with 1 click.
description: A modal dialog accessible via 'UX Case Study' button documenting the 5 key improvements: Natural Language Config Bar, Click-to-Rename, Smart Bulk Selection, Schema Guardrails, and Action-Oriented CTA.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'UX Case Study' opens #uxNotesModal with backdrop blur.
Presents 5 detailed case study cards with rationale and code examples.
Clicking '✕' or 'Got it' closes the modal smoothly.
cognitive_load_optimization: Provides instant on-demand design documentation directly inside the interactive artifact.

title: Non-Blocking Toast Notification System (#toastNotice)
user_request_origin: Floating Toast Notification (No alert() used)
user_story: As a user performing actions (copying, filtering, adding columns, applying schema), I want non-blocking toast notifications in the bottom-right corner instead of disruptive browser alert() popups.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Native `alert()` boxes block the UI thread, require manual dismissal, and disrupt user focus. A non-blocking toast notification sliding into the corner provides instant confirmation and automatically fades out without interrupting workflow.
description: A floating toast notification component positioned at fixed bottom-right with emerald status indicator, smooth slide-up animation, and auto-dismiss timer.
acceptance_criteria: All actions (Copy, Add Field, Smart Filter, Remove Field, Apply) trigger non-blocking toasts.
Toast slides up smoothly from bottom-right and auto-dismisses after 2.2 seconds.
Never invokes native browser alert() or confirm() dialogs.
Subsequent toasts reset the dismissal timer cleanly.
cognitive_load_optimization: Eliminates modal interruption, allowing users to maintain uninterrupted flow during log exploration.

title: 50-Row Sample Event Simulation Pool
user_request_origin: Sample events pool (50 simulated rows)
user_story: As a tester or engineer, I want a pool of 50 diverse sample events representing realistic system payloads (IIS, Nginx, Windows Security, Microservices) so I can verify parsing robustness across real-world edge cases.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Testing with only 1 or 2 static sample lines fails to uncover latent field variations and delimiter edge cases. Providing a 50-row realistic sample pool allows thorough verification of auto-detection and token splitting.
description: A built-in array of 50 diverse sample log events accessible via the Prev/Next row cycler, covering various delimiter patterns, quoting styles, and numeric formats.
acceptance_criteria: Sample pool contains 50 realistic log strings spanning varied system architectures.
Cycling row index updates the sample editor textarea immediately.
Live SQL and discovered field mappings update reactively to each sample event.
Includes edge cases: multi-word quoted values, escaped backslashes, and unquoted integers.
cognitive_load_optimization: Provides immediate access to rich test data without requiring manual payload crafting.

title: 13 Discovered Fields Initial Data Model Matching Pixel-Perfect Spec
user_request_origin: 13 Discovered Fields matching the exact screenshot top 5 + 8 scrollable fields
user_story: As an engineer, I want the mockup initialized with 13 realistic discovered fields (str1, LID, Type, Proc, PID, Status, DurationMs, Host, Retries, SessionID, ClientIP, AuthMethod, ExitCode) matching the screenshot exactly.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Pre-populating the data grid with 13 realistic fields representing varied types (VARCHAR, BIGINT), rates (from 8% to 100%), and values provides an authentic, high-fidelity experience that reflects real log parsing workloads.
description: Array `discoveredFields` containing 13 objects with id, key, type, rate, sample, newName, checked, and isPositional properties matching parse_columns_mockup.html.
acceptance_criteria: Initializes with exactly 13 fields.
Top fields match screenshot: str1 (100%), LID (82%), Type (82%), Proc (12%), PID (10%), Status (64%).
Positional fields marked with isPositional: true and amber badge styling.
Table dynamically reacts to field checking, renaming, type changes, and deletion.
cognitive_load_optimization: Demonstrates real-world density and data hierarchy without synthetic placeholder labels.

title: Classic Desktop & Minimalist Zen Custom Scrollbars
user_request_origin: Classic Windows/Desktop scrollbar replica và Minimalist Zen Mode overrides
user_story: As a user, I want custom scrollbar styling (.classic-scrollbar) matching classic desktop tools in Original mode, and refined ultra-sleek 5px transparent track scrollbars in Zen mode.
rationale_and_design_decisions: Default browser scrollbars are often visually clunky. Custom webkit scrollbar rules provide an authentic desktop feel in classic mode and an ultra-clean, modern aesthetic in Zen mode.
description: CSS rules defining `.classic-scrollbar` with 15px width and desktop borders, overridden in `.zen-mode` to 5px width with transparent track and pill thumb.
acceptance_criteria: In classic mode, scrollbars render with 15px track and desktop borders.
In zen mode, scrollbars render with 5px track, transparent background, and rounded thumb.
Hover states provide clear visual feedback.
cognitive_load_optimization: Eliminates visual friction by ensuring scrollbars harmonize with the active design edition.
